method.query: SELECT s.id,t.v,t.pos FROM src s,LATERAL TABLE(concrete_rows(s.id,s.p)) AS t(v,pos)
method.source: Runtime sequence selecting 64 prebuilt arrays, matched scalar values/NULLs/widths in both engines.
method.function: ConcreteRows reuses actual LinkedList, Vector or custom ResultList; mutable output copied during collection.
method.resources: one task, heap state, 3 GiB heap, 1024-row transpose batches
method.order: Stock/native alternate order within each trial; each case/revision is a separate JVM, all serial.
method.timing: Submission through completion after symmetric EXPLAIN preflight, with both transposes, production JNI, callbacks, List conversion, owned Arrow writes and blackhole sink retained.
method.evidence: Every candidate job asserts consumed NativeTableFunction input and both transposes; every previous job asserts zero substitutions and no native operators.
method.interference: No overlapping local builds/tests/benchmarks during timed jobs; host process snapshots sampled every 10 seconds.
method.limits: Short jobs include startup/JIT. Independent stock controls expose separate-JVM drift; all warmups/trials and unfavorable ranges are retained.
